[{"insert":"Barbell Z Press
 
The barbell Z press is the main overhead lift this cycle. Sitting on the floor with the legs straight out takes away every bit of leg drive and any chance to lean back, so the shoulders and the midline do all the work. The 20X1 tempo means two seconds down, no pause, then press and hold tall for one at the top. The last set is max unbroken reps at your Set 1 weight, so save something for it.
"}]
